title: Portuguese Lasagna with Golden Cheese
description: A delicious twist on the classic lasagna, infused with the flavors of Portugal. This dish is perfect for a cozy dinner with family and friends.
instructions: Cook Jovial Lasagna Noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, sauté minced garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add Portuguese-Style Meat Sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine cooked noodles, meat sauce, and shredded Golden Cheese. Mix well.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top with additional shredded Golden Cheese and chopped parsley.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
